描述_EN: this offering jar has a simple carved pattern of lotus petals and buds. this was a common burial ritual in song china, particularly in south china, and funerary jars containing rice were buried in pairs. such jars would have been filled with offerings of rice for the souls of the dead, and then buried in the tombs of the wealthy. this decoration may be significant, for it is linked with buddhist beliefs about rebirth in the western paradise.
描述_ZN: 这个供奉罐有一个简单的莲花花瓣和花蕾的雕刻图案。 这是宋代中国常见的葬仪，尤其是在中国南方，装米的陪葬品罐子是成对埋葬的。 这种罐子会装满供奉给死者灵魂的米，然后埋在富人的坟墓里。 这种装饰可能是重要的，因为它与佛教关于在西方极乐世界重生的信仰有关。
